title: Salamun Alaika Ya Aba Abdillah
body:
Hussain..........
<<MINI>>
Safar hayat ka chahe tamam hota rahe
<<DIVIDER>>
Hazar dard ho, zikr-e-Imam hota rahe.
Salam hota rahe *3
Fatima ke chain ko *2
Nabi k noor-e-aain ko.*2
Ba khuda Husain (A.S) ko Salam.... To Kaho
<<MINI>>
Salamun Alaika Ya Aba Abdillah *4
Safar hayat ka chahe tamam hota rahe *2
<<DIVIDER>>
Salaam hota rahe*3
<<MINI>>
Maulana Hussain Hussain, Maulana Hussain rey..*2
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Haan... Sara zamana hai tumhara hussain, kehti hai har qaum humara hussain
Gunjta har simt hai naara Hussain, tutey dilon ka sahara Hussain
Muala tera naam sada zinda rahega, maula tera kaam sada zinda rahega
<<MINI>>
Hum rahe na rahe ye sada zinda rahega.
Salamun Alaika Ya Aba Abdillah*2
Salam hussain, maula salam hussain
Salam Hussain
Salam hussain, maula salam hussain*2
Salam Hussain
Salam hussain, maula salam hussain*2
Salam Hussain
Maulana Hussain Hussain, Maulana Hussain rey..*2
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Haan.... Muala hussain ibn-e-Ali (a.s) marhaba
Marhaba sadd marhaba sadd marhaba, zulm k tufaan se ladhta raha kat ke be sar apka uncha raha.
Maula sada teri azadaari rahegi, maula tere hum se wafadari rahegi
<<MINI>>
Hum rahe na rahe ye sada zinda rahe.
Salamun Alaika Ya Aba Abdillah*2
Maula hussain maula humara salam lo, Maula hussain maula humari sada suno *2
Maulana Hussain Hussain, Maulana Hussain rey..*2
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Haan..Apka maula jo azadar hai
Apke ghar ka vo wafadar hai
apki chahat ka talabgar hai
Majlis-o-matam se usse pyaar hai
Maula ghulamo me mera naam b likhdo..
Naam to naukar ka hai vo kaam b likhdo...
<<MINI>>
Hum rahe na rahe ye sada zinda rahe
Salamun Alaika Ya Aba Abdillah*2
Salam hussain, maula salam hussain
Salam Hussain
Salam hussain, maula salam hussain*2
Salam Hussain
Salam hussain, maula salam hussain
Salam Hussain
Salam hussain, maula salam hussain*1
Maulana Hussain Hussain, Maulana Hussain rey..*2
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Haan, pyara hai mitha hai madina mera, Rehte jahan sondey nabi Mustafa(SAWA)
Jisne diya humko ye deen-e-khuda Aur nawasa bana uski baqaa
Aao chalo karbobala tumko dekhaye
Aj bhi aati hai bahatar ki sadayein
<<MINI>>
Hum rahe na rahe ye sada zinda rahe
Salamun Alaika Ya Aba Abdillah*2
Maula hussain maula humara salam lo, Maula hussain maula humari sada suno *2
Maulana Hussain Hussain, Maulana Hussain rey..*2
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Haan.. Sheh k azadaro salamat raho
Maula k paigham ko jari rakho
Amno mohabbat ki hifazat karo
Dil ko yuhi dil se milate raho
Maula ka tum aqri sajda na bhulana..
Matami bacchon ko namazi bhi bana na...
<<MINI>>
Hum rahe na rahe ye sada zinda rahe
Salamun Alaika Ya Aba Abdillah*2
Safar hayat ka chahe tamam hota rahe *1
<<DIVIDER>>
Salam hota rahe *3
Mere maula mere agha hussain
Hussain vo hai jisse karbala salaam kare
Nabi Ali-o-Hassan Fatima salaam kare
Hussain maula ki azmat bayan kaise ho
Hussain vo hai jisse kibriya salam kare
<<MINI>>
Salam Hussain, Salam Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye shah e shahida, Aye Jaan-e-Madina
Aye Naaz-e-Fakhira
Maula-e-Ghariba
Rote sisakti hai duniya bilakti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
har aankh har lamha inse jhalakti hai
Dil dil se miladey zehno ko sajadey
Phoolo ko khiladey, kaanto ko hatadey
Allah k wasiley, Ahmed k nawase
<<DIVIDER>>
Hyder k sitarey, Zehra k dularey
Hai Agha humarey...
<<MINI>>
Salam Hussain, Salam Hussain, Salam Hussain..*5
<<DIVIDER>>
Aao Azadaro karo matam-e- sarwar karo
<<MINI>>
Ya Hussain, Hussain ya hussain, Hussain..
<<DIVIDER>>
Matam-e-Abbas karo
Matam-e-Akbar karo
<<MINI>>
Ya Hussain, Hussain ya hussain, Hussain..
<<DIVIDER>>
Bali Sakina ka kabhi, matam-e-Asghar karo.*2
Zainab-o-Kulsum ka gham matam-e-chadar karo
Haan.. Shah sala mun alay
<<MINI>>
Ya mere Maula Salam, Shah sala mun alay
Ya mere agha salaam, Shah sala mun alay
<<DIVIDER>>
Qasim-o-Akbar salam, Shah sala mun alay
Abid-o-Akbar Salam, Shah sala mun alay
Ghazi dilawar Salam, Shah sala mun alay
Haye Zainab-o-Kulsum Salam, Shah sala mun alay
Aon-o-Mohammad Salaam, Shah sala mun alay
Pyasi Sakina salam, Shah sala mun alay*2
<<MINI>>
Ya mere Maula Salam, Shah sala mun alay
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya mere Maula Salaam... Hussain * 9
